mapper.select: select count(1) from settlement where batch_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into settlement (batch_no, semester_id, month, dept_id, total_hours, total_amount, detail_count, status, confirm_user, confirm_time, pay_user, pay_time, remark, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{batchNo}, #{semesterId}, #{month}, #{deptId}, #{totalHours}, #{totalAmount}, #{detailCount}, #{status}, #{confirmUser}, #{confirmTime}, #{payUser}, #{payTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select st.*, d.name as deptName, se.name as semesterName from settlement st left join dept d on st.dept_id = d.id left join sys_semester se on st.semester_id = se.id where st.id = #{id}
